metrics.name: Kidney health evaluation for patients with diabetes (eGFR and uACR)
metrics.summary: Denominator: diabetics aged 18-85. Numerator: at least one dated eGFR and at least one dated urine albumin-creatinine ratio, both with event_date in the measurement year. Percent.

age.note: age_latest per nl2sql RULES; benchmark references disagree (O31 roster age_reported, M33 latest age)

numerator.summary: Both an eGFR and a uACR dated in the year.

egfr.provenance: concepts.MEASUREMENTS egfr LOINC list (public LOINC codes; licensed KED value sets not used)

uacr.provenance: concepts.MEASUREMENTS uacr LOINC list; urine albumin alone is not a ratio

metrics.sql_template: SELECT 100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.patient_id = p.patient_id AND m.concept = 'egfr' AND m.value_canonical IS NOT NULL AND m.event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.patient_id = p.patient_id AND m.concept = 'uacr' AND m.value_canonical IS NOT NULL AND m.event_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}') THEN p.patient_id END) / count(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS pct_kidney_health_evaluation FROM patient p JOIN concept_patient cp ON cp.patient_id = p.patient_id AND cp.concept = 'diabetes' WHERE p.age_latest BETWEEN 18 AND 85

metrics.name: Respiratory registry (asthma or COPD)
metrics.internal_reason: Registry phenotype from the Agere concept library (ICD-10-CM J43/J44/J45 prefixes plus source labels); documentation-level, not a certified value set.
metrics.summary: Distinct patients with an asthma or COPD condition record (COPD includes emphysema and chronic obstructive bronchitis). All ages. Patient list.

numerator.summary: Patients with condition concept asthma or copd.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM concept_patient WHERE concept IN ('asthma','copd') ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Patients with any LDL cholesterol >= 190 mg/dL (possible familial hypercholesterolemia)

citations.title: 2018 AHA/ACC/AACVPR/AAPA/ABC/ACPM/ADA/AGS/APhA/ASPC/NLA/PCNA Guideline on the Management of Blood Cholesterol (Grundy et al., Circulation 2019;139:e1082-e1143)

metrics.summary: Distinct patients with any numeric, non-cancelled LDL cholesterol result >= 190 mg/dL, dated or undated (timing does not matter for an FH screen).

ldl.provenance: concepts.MEASUREMENTS ldl LOINC list + received labels

checks.why: any result counts, dated or undated (most LDL results are undated)

metrics.sql_template: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM measurement WHERE concept = 'ldl' AND value_canonical >= 190 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Older adults dispensed a Beers-list high-risk medication

citations.title: American Geriatrics Society 2023 updated AGS Beers Criteria for potentially inappropriate medication use in older adults (J Am Geriatr Soc 2023;71(7):2052-2081)

metrics.summary: Patients aged 65+ with at least one pharmacy dispense (status 'dispensed' or paid claim) of a first-generation antihistamine, benzodiazepine, meperidine or skeletal muscle relaxant, at any date. Second-generation antihistamines (loratadine, cetirizine, fexofenadine) are not Beers-list drugs.

age.note: age_latest per nl2sql RULES; the O11 reference uses roster age_reported

numerator.summary: Patients with a dispensed Beers-list drug.

beers_drugs.provenance: AGS Beers Criteria 2023 (first-generation antihistamines, benzodiazepines, meperidine, skeletal muscle relaxants); RxNorm ingredients via the normalization dictionary

metrics.sql_template: SELECT count(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patients FROM patient p JOIN medication m ON m.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE p.age_latest >= 65 AND m.evidence IN ('dispensed','claim') AND (m.drug_class IN ('first_generation_antihistamine','benzodiazepine','skeletal_muscle_relaxant') OR lower(m.drug_name) LIKE '%meperidine%')

metrics.name: Heart failure patients with no beta-blocker on record
metrics.summary: Patients with heart failure (library concept) with no beta-blocker (drug_class beta_blocker, any evidence: dispensed, claim, ordered, listed, administered, reported) anywhere in their medication records.

numerator.summary: HF patients with no beta_blocker medication row.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT DISTINCT cp.patient_id FROM concept_patient cp WHERE cp.concept = 'heart_failure' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM medication m WHERE m.patient_id = cp.patient_id AND m.drug_class = 'beta_blocker') ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Adults with BMI >= 30 computed from latest weight and height
metrics.internal_reason: Computed phenotype (BMI = kg / m^2 from the latest weight and a height); CDC adult BMI cut-off 30 is the convention.
metrics.summary: Adults (18+) whose BMI = weight kg / (height m)^2 is >= 30, with height from the vitals height measurement (an undated baseline) and weight = the latest dated weight, else the undated baseline weight. The obesity diagnosis is not used.

checks.why: the question asks for a BMI computed from height and weight, not the obesity diagnosis
height is an undated baseline measurement; requiring a dated height drops every patient

metrics.sql_template: WITH h AS (SELECT patient_id, max(value) / 100.0 AS m FROM measurement WHERE source_table = 'vitals' AND name = 'height_cm' AND value > 0 GROUP BY patient_id), w AS (SELECT p.patient_id, coalesce((SELECT value_canonical FROM measurement_latest l WHERE l.patient_id = p.patient_id AND l.concept = 'weight'), (SELECT max(value_canonical) FROM measurement m WHERE m.patient_id = p.patient_id AND m.concept = 'weight' AND m.event_date IS NULL)) AS kg FROM patient p WHERE p.age_latest >= 18) SELECT count(*) AS adults_bmi_30_plus FROM w JOIN h ON h.patient_id = w.patient_id WHERE w.kg / (h.m * h.m) >= 30
